author: nickyeow

english.text: Showing your real feelings is not considered a virtue in Japan.

jyutping: zik6 seot1 hai2 jat6 bun2 jan4 ge3 ngaan5 leoi5 min6 bing6 m4 hai6 jat1 zung2 mei5 dak1。
text: 直率喺日本人嘅眼裏面並唔係一種美德。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The bridge is approximately a mile long.

jyutping: tiu4 kiu4 daai6 joek3 jau5 jat1 mai1 coeng4。
text: 條橋大約有一咪長。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I want all of the furniture taken to our house right away.

jyutping: m4 goi1 zik1 hak1 zoeng1 di1 gaa1 si1 sung3 saai3 heoi3 ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 aa1。
text: 唔該即刻將啲傢俬送晒去我哋屋企吖。

author: nickyeow

english.text: She asked him to not quit his job.

jyutping: keoi5 giu3 keoi5 m4 hou2 ci4 zo2 fan6 gung1 keoi5。
text: 佢叫佢唔好辭咗份工佢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You can't buy anything if you have no money.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 mou5 cin4，gan1 bun2 me1 dou1 maai5 m4 dou3。
text: 如果你冇錢，根本咩都買唔到。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Leave me a bit of ice cream.

jyutping: lau4 di1 syut3 gou1 bei2 ngo5。
text: 留啲雪糕俾我。

author: kaenif

english.text: It's unlikely she's as stupid as you think.

jyutping: keoi5 mou5 mat1 gei1 wui6 wui6 hai6 nei5 soeng2 zoeng6 zung1 gam3 ceon2。
text: 佢冇乜機會會係你想像中咁蠢。

author: fercheung

english.text: You need to have breakfast.

jyutping: nei5 jiu3 sik6 zou2 caan1 aa3。
text: 你要食早餐啊。

author: kaenif

english.text: Everything is upside down.

jyutping: mat1 dou1 diu6 zyun2 saai3。
text: 乜都掉轉曬。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom is probably still at home.

jyutping: dyun3 gu2 aa3 Tom jing1 goi1 zung6 hai2 uk1 kei2。
text: 斷估阿Tom應該仲喺屋企。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Regardless of whether you come tomorrow or not, let me know.

jyutping: nei5 ting1 jat6 lai4 m4 lai4 dou1 waa6 seng1 bei2 ngo5 teng1 aa1。
text: 你聽日嚟唔嚟都話聲俾我聽吖。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I fell in love with you.
I've fallen in love with you.

jyutping: ngo5 oi3 soeng5 zo2 nei5。
text: 我愛上咗你。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I realize I'm new here, but I have a suggestion.

jyutping: ngo5 zi1 ngo5 hai6 san1 lai4 ge3，daan6 hai6 ngo5 jau5 jat1 go3 gin3 ji5。
text: 我知我係新嚟嘅，但係我有一個建議。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Any universe simple enough to be understood is too simple to produce a mind able to understand it.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 jat1 go3 jyu5 zau6 gaan2 daan1 dou3 ho2 ji5 bei2 jan4 ming4 baak6，gam3 zau6 zing3 zing3 jan1 wai6 keoi5 taai3 gwo3 gaan2 daan1，so2 ji5 caan2 sang1 m4 dou3 ming4 baak6 dou3 keoi5 ge3 ji3 sik1 tai2。
text: 如果一個宇宙簡單到可以俾人明白，咁就正正因為佢太過簡單，所以產生唔到明白到佢嘅意識體。

author: nickyeow

english.text: All of my books are digital.

jyutping: ngo5 di1 syu1 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 din6 zi2 syu1 lai4 ge3。
text: 我啲書全部都係電子書嚟嘅。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What's your major?

jyutping: nei5 maj me1 gaa3？
text: 你maj咩㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: He's a newcomer.

jyutping: keoi5 san1 lai4 gaa3。
text: 佢新嚟㗎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Messi scored a spectacular goal.

jyutping: mei5 si1 jap6 zo2 kau4 sai3 gaai3 bo1。
text: 美斯入咗球世界波。

author: nickyeow

english.text: My religion is simple: I believe whatever I want.

jyutping: ngo5 soeng1 seon3 ge3 je5 hou2 gaan2 daan1：zau6 hai6 ngo5 zung1 ji3 soeng1 seon3 di1 me1，zau6 ho2 ji5 soeng1 seon3 di1 me1。
text: 我相信嘅嘢好簡單：就係我鍾意相信啲咩，就可以相信啲咩。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Everything was going well at first.

jyutping: jat1 hoi1 ci2 hou2 seon6 lei6 ge3。
text: 一開始好順利嘅。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Adriano confronted Rima about Walid.

jyutping: aa3 zin1 nou4 ji5 waa4 lit6 gei3 si6 zat1 man6 lei6 maa5。
text: 阿箋奴以華列既事質問利瑪。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Tom bought three bottles of beer.

jyutping: aa3 tong1 maai5 zo2 saam1 gun3 be1 zau2。
text: 阿湯買咗三罐啤酒。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Did you break any dishes?

jyutping: nei5 jau5 mou4 daa2 laan6 dip6 aa3？
text: 你有無打爛碟啊？

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: There are two types of political correctness which are often conflated and which should be distinguished. There is the political correctness of language, which holds that certain groups should not be referred to by certain words with negative connotations (e.g., ethnic slurs), and there is the political correctness of ideas, which holds that certain ideas should not be discussed. The former is arguably commendable; the latter is harmful.

jyutping: zing3 zi6 zing3 kok3 jau5 loeng5 zung2 ging1 soeng4 bei6 wan6 ngaau4，daan6 jing1 goi1 fan1 hoi1 lai4 gong2 ge3 leoi6 jing4。jat1 zung2 hai6 jyu5 jin4 soeng6 ge3 zing3 zi6 zing3 kok3，jing6 wai4 mau5 se1 kwan4 tai2 m4 jing1 goi1 bei6 jung6 daai2 fu6 min2 ji3 mei6 ge3 zi6 ngaan5 cing1 fu1（lai6 jyu4 zung2 zuk6 mou5 juk6 ci4）；ling6 jat1 zung2 hai6 lei5 nim6 soeng6 ge3 zing3 zi6 zing3 kok3，jing6 wai4 mau5 se1 soeng2 faat3 m4 jing1 goi1 bei6 tou2 leon6。cin4 ze2 ho2 ji5 waa6 hai6 zik6 dak1 zaan3 heoi2 ge3；hau6 ze2 zak1 jau5 hoi6。
text: 政治正確有兩種經常被混淆，但應該分開嚟講嘅類型。一種係語言上嘅政治正確，認為某些群體唔應該被用帶負面意味嘅字眼稱呼（例如種族侮辱詞）；另一種係理念上嘅政治正確，認為某些想法唔應該被討論。前者可以話係值得讚許嘅；後者則有害。

author: LeeSooHa

english.text: Why do you speak Cantonese so well when you just came to Canton?

jyutping: dim2 gaai2 nei5 ngaam1 lai4 gwong2 zau1 baak6 waa6 zau6 gong2 dak1 gam3 hou2 ne1？
text: 點解你啱嚟廣州白話就講得咁好呢？
